selection: 35% 2020-2023 utility + 65% mean post-2024 fold utility - 0.30 fold Sharpe dispersion; recent drawdown <=35%, legacy <=55%, recent cycles >=30
causal_gate: daily bull means completed daily close above daily EMA90 and daily EMA90 slope positive; no calendar rule
execution: 1m fills, 1bps base slippage, 8bps*sqrt(participation) impact, real funding, conservative protection
disclosure: All data through August 2026 has been viewed in prior rounds; this is a procedural holdout exercise, not a historically blind test.
